title: Held-Days Uplift on Mobile Wallet Resend Rates
content:
Service commitment for **Mobile Wallet** customers whose money has waited with Paloma before a resend.

**Uplift rule.** The held-days uplift on a resend follows the days the resend has waited, counted in calendar days from the starting date of its wait to today:

| Days waited | Held-days uplift |
|---|---|
| 14 or more | 0.30 points |
| at least 7 and fewer than 14 | 0.15 points |
| fewer than 7 | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, wait starting 2026-06-01)

| Today | Calendar days waited | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-07 | 6 | nothing |
| 2026-06-08 | 7 | 0.15 points |
| 2026-06-14 | 13 | 0.15 points |
| 2026-06-15 | 14 | 0.30 points |
